excerpt: Download Buddy: the AI mobile browser by Whim Studio, Inc. on the App Store. See screenshots, ratings and reviews, user tips, and more apps like Buddy: the AI…
content_html:
Complete web tasks for you

Free · In‑App Purchases · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS.

Tell Buddy the task—compare options, fill a web form, research a purchase, or plan a trip—and it does the work for you. Tell Buddy what needs doing online. It can compare options, research a purchase, fill a web form, or plan a trip—right in the browser, with you in control. Features include: - AI-powered web navigation - Text and voice requests - Form filling and repetitive task automation - Multi-site research and comparisons - A full mobile browsing experience Less tapping. Less busywork. More done. Terms of Service/Use: https://www.buddybrowser.ai/terms

为您完成网络任务

免费 · 应用内购买 · 专为 iPad 设计。 未针对 macOS 进行验证。

告诉 Buddy 任务 - 比较选项、填写网络表格、研究购买或计划旅行 - 它会为你完成工作。 告诉好友需要在线做什么。 它可以比较选项、研究购买、填写网络表格或计划旅行——就在浏览器中，一切尽在您的掌控之中。 功能包括： - 人工智能驱动的网络导航 - 文本和语音请求 - 表单填写和重复任务自动化 - 多站点研究和比较 - 完整的移动浏览体验 更少的点击。 少些忙碌。 做得更多。 服务/使用条款：https://www.buddybrowser.ai/terms
